_how_to_extend: When you add a feature, add one question here with its defining file and symbol (symbol = the function/class name; alt_symbols = other acceptable defining names). Mark must_hit true only for lexical questions that locate must always HIT. Paraphrase questions are reported, never gated. test_symbol_coverage already covers every new def/class/method automatically.
